events.line: Rinor actually benched this guy last week and watched him pop off, so of course he starts him this week and Bucky decides to go full anime protagonist—absolutely demolished that projection like it personally insulted his family. Maybe trust your own fucking eyes next time instead of whatever crystal ball told you to sit him before.
CeeDee put up 1.9 fucking points and you started him anyway—might as well have thrown a dart at your bench and hoped for better, Flamur, because that projection was a god damn fantasy.

Pickens went absolutely nuclear this week and Ilir still somehow managed to look like a genius for starting him—even though that projection had him as a mid-tier flex play, this motherfucker just doubled down and exploded all over the place.
Rilind, starting Bhayshul Tuten and getting 1.6 points has to be one of the most creative ways to actively sabotage your own season—congrats on the commitment to losing.

Trevor Lawrence put up 7.8 points and Flamur out here acting like he didn't just start a QB that shit the bed harder than a toddler after Taco Bell—maybe next time don't ride the "he'll bounce back" hype train straight off a cliff.

You started Cowboys D/ST and watched them get absolutely skull-fucked for -2 points when you were expecting 7, so basically you took a -9 point swing straight to the nuts this week—that's what happens when you trust Dallas to do literally anything competently.

Arben really said "you know what my team needs? Zero fucking points from the slot receiver position" and just rolled with it—Meyers put up a donut while projecting for nearly 9, so congrats on that masterclass in lineup management.

Rilind really said "you know what this team needs? Zero fucking points from the wide receiver spot" and started Darius Cooper like it was a guaranteed path to success—congrats on the 7.5 point swing in the wrong direction, you absolute genius.
Flamur actually looked like he knew what the fuck he was doing for once—Egbuka went off for 14.2 when everyone said he'd crap out with 8, so congrats on accidentally having a brain this week.
Rinor, Dak put up a wet fart this week and you had the balls to start him anyway—that's the kind of decision-making that explains why your season's circling the drain.
